body:
[A10] Documentation residue from the #500 design lane; track here as T7, outside the Proposed contract diff.

# Docs: the saved-state page's area table for KL_nvm_backend predates the #484 contract

## Observed

`docs/design/SAVED_STATE_FASTCONNECT.md` section 8.3 lists `KL_nvm_backend`
at 772 LUT and 377 FF at the 1x1 bound (`N_NAME_P` 30). At dev `07294a76` the
tracked recipe returns 1,030 LUT, 0 LUTRAM, 468 FF, 6 DSP, 114 CARRY4 for the
same parameters:

    OOC_CHPARAM="N_STREAM_IN_P=2 N_STREAM_OUT_P=2 N_SPORT_IN_P=1 N_SPORT_OUT_P=1 \
                 N_AUDIO_UNIT_P=1 N_CLK_DOM_P=1 N_NAME_P=30" syn/yosys/ooc.sh KL_nvm_backend

The snapshot-ownership contract of #484 grew the module (its page section 18
priced the prototype at 1,051 LUT and 476 FF). The shipped shapes also moved:
1x1 now carries 38 names (1,051 LUT, 476 FF) and 8x8 99 (1,476 LUT with 128
LUTRAM, 515 FF).

## Acceptance

Section 8.3's rows restated at the current source and the current name
bounds, with the recipe; the "above the candidate's bound" paragraph
re-derived.

Public recipe and measurements: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/a21b165ac1c671d10cba7255beaf75cea0f81d18/design-evidence/500-materialization/COMMAND_RESULTS.md . No implementation or documentation update is claimed by this record.

[A10] DONOR HISTORICAL AUDIT OBSERVATION - no checklist item closed

At protocol-processor main424c688fa2205b934a7689a58f2aa766420f2326, before donorPR96 lands, parent-owned auditors targeting main report two pre-existing unknown branch-continuity histories (donorPR13 and PR6, post-merge deletion recorded) and two negative merges (donorPR13 and PR9). Both scans exit1. This is retained as historical audit debt, not a new claim about PR96 or a claim that older findings are resolved. Do not reconstruct same-name branches and call that continuity.

Scope and exact-candidate distinction are public in donorPR96's historical-baseline comment. PR96's own head/tree containment and two-review bar remain mandatory. No source, gate, acceptance criterion, historical review or checklist completion was changed.

[A10] PP (protocol processor) links for existing residue; no new duplicate checklist or criterion closure.

- The model-ID evolution residue already listed here overlaps the parent side of https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/38. PP owns its generic image lint; the parent owns its generated model identity and generator-owned field coverage. The broader descriptor-contract audit will reference this existing item.
- Optional SET_CLOCK_SOURCE refusal-branch test residue from closed parent #389 is already filed in PP: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/37. Execution remains in the PP test suite.

The exhaustive PP audit index on #415 records the other donor-only documentation/tooling/test tasks without creating parent implementation tickets. Missing listener status values and the parent MVU requirement conflict need separate concrete contracts; they are not closed by adding a residue link.

These links are references only. A PP defect or verification gap retains its donor severity and full acceptance criteria. Appearing here does not reclassify it as an optional suggestion, waive a requirement, or clear review coverage.

[Complete PP (protocol processor) audit and donor ownership index](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/415#issuecomment-5772947045).
Descriptor-contract coordination: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/509.

[A10] PP (protocol processor) descriptor-artifact residue from #464

Added one checklist item here, reusing the established residue owner rather than creating a duplicate issue. At dev ec34fcdee0ca9ffa63564a9af8ad70a3a618de29 the tracked avdecc/aem_rom.json differs from fresh generation at four ROM byte offsets: 118-119 (firmware_version), 1117 (AVB_INTERFACE port_number), and 1467 (CONTROL IDENTIFY reset_time). The #464 author reproduced the same drift before and after its change; generated shipping outputs are byte-identical. No current gate or runtime consumer reads this tracked snapshot according to the documented source census.

Evidence and reproduction: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/d0d27ffe456962bba9d619278e572900d4ee2bde/review-evidence/464-r1/author/receipts/preexisting_aem_rom_json_drift.txt and https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/d0d27ffe456962bba9d619278e572900d4ee2bde/review-evidence/464-r1/author/receipts/decode_aem_rom_drift.py . This is a pre-existing unused-artifact observation, not a #464 review finding or a PP runtime defect, and no review coverage is cleared by this routing. Disposition (regenerate and enforce versus remove/label unused snapshot) remains open before implementation. #509 retains the separate PP image-rule ownership decision; closed #462/#463 product fixes remain closed.

[A10] PP (protocol processor) residue routing from #512: R222-1 optional S1/S2 are now checklist lines here, with the original review link. Current hand-built AUDIO_UNIT values agree, and the loader/image distinction changes no shipping rate. No duplicate issue was created and neither suggestion was inserted into #478's frozen correction. #509 remains the descriptor ownership/design contract.

[A10] PR #513 review leftovers are recorded above as three optional PP (protocol processor) AEM fixture/self-test checklist entries: [R235-1 S1/S2/S3](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/513#issuecomment-5777556715). They are not adopted in #464 and retain SUGGESTION severity. The reviewed repair is clean under all five lenses; these are wording and additional pre-existing coverage opportunities, not new reachable product defects or #509 ownership requirements. No duplicate issue.

[A10] Recorded R238 F3 from PR #515 as an unchecked optional follow-up in this existing checklist. Its original SUGGESTION classification and Conformance/Robustness lenses remain unchanged. The entry names the escape and withholding probes, retains the documented omission ownership, and links the exact public reproducer. No duplicate optional-work Issue and no implied acceptance of #515's open MAJOR findings.
